## AC2 evidence — per-pair node counts reconcile

The completion verifier correctly found this unrecorded: the implementation
comment asserted the merges were clean but never showed the per-pair
`pytest --collect-only -q` tables the Testing section requires. Measured now.

Method — one collection pass per tree, counted per file (no per-file pytest
invocations, so the counts cannot drift between runs):

- **before** = parent commit `bd79355895735680809734d038f4a556aaef77c1`,
  collecting both members of each pair
- **after** = merged commit `764af7abb7650a0a5c95e68ed729547660055b71`,
  collecting the surviving base alone
- both with `-m ""` so no marker deselection distorts the count, and
  `-p no:randomly` for a stable order

| base module | base | heldout | before | after | |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

| tests/interfaces/contracts/test_llmrunner_error_codes_f75f.py | 2 | 14 | 16 | 16 | OK |

Every merged base collects exactly the sum of its two predecessors, so the
merge neither dropped nor duplicated a single test node. The criterion was
satisfied by the change all along; only the evidence was missing.
